instruction: Add the email 'testuser2024@gmail.com' to Thunderbird using 'gmailpass123' as the password, and finish the account configuration even if you encounter login or connection errors; credential verification will be done afterwards.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Gmail account setup task. User must configure both IMAP (imap.gmail.com) and SMTP (smtp.gmail.com) servers with credentials testuser2024@gmail.com / gmailpass123. Evaluator uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved account credentials from Thunderbird profile and validates both incoming and outgoing mail server configurations are present. Same complexity as original task - requires multi-step account setup with both IMAP and SMTP configuration.
metadata.verification: Task validated against Thunderbird account setup process. Gmail uses standard IMAP (imap.gmail.com) and SMTP (smtp.gmail.com) servers. The check_csv metric will verify both mail server entries exist with correct credentials.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if both IMAP and SMTP accounts are configured correctly with specified credentials, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can effectively verify task completion

Expected values are accurate: Gmail uses standard imap.gmail.com and smtp.gmail.com servers
Complete coverage: verifies both incoming (IMAP) and outgoing (SMTP) mail server configurations as required by the instruction
